quest.title: The Siege of Qingce
quest.description: The Millelith soldier Jinglun is fretting about how to defeat the monsters around Qingce Village...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other matters to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Um... Alright then. It's fine, we'll think of another way to deal with those monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Great! I'll call the others, and we'll head out immediately. The quicker we settle this, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Let's meet back here once we've defeated them all.

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and clear all the obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: That won't do... We need reinforcements...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've cleaned the monsters out.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, but I'm afraid there's been an emergency.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: I'd assumed that the monsters around Qingce Village were all the ordinary sort...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: I'd just led some troops to clean out one monster camp, and we were looking to get some rest before continuing.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: But that was when a Stonehide Lawachurl came charging out of the nearby woods...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: It was upon us before we could even react, and many were injured... We were forced to fall back.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: That monster is too huge a threat to be left alone, but the other detachments have yet to return from clearing their targets out...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Could you help us defeat that monster, Traveler?

response.speaker: Jinglun
response.text: I will, thank you. I'm really sorry... This should have been our task.

response.speaker: Jinglun
response.text: We were able to get help in time, so no one is in serious danger... But they'll have trouble moving about for a while.

response.speaker: Jinglun
response.text: As such, I'm afraid it's all up to you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Jinglun
response.text: I'm very sorry. This should have been our duty...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you defeat that monster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: That's great... I suppose we can finally rest easy now.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here's a token of our appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: ...Still, it doesn't add up. Why would such a creature suddenly show up near Qingce Village?

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Regardless, I'll have to report this matter to the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: I hope that they'll be able to send us more people...

talks.objective: Return to Qingce Village and report back to Jinglun

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Traveler, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: It's about Qingce Village again. Those meteorites that came down have caused the monsters around the village to go wild. They've been rampaging across the roads, and Qingce Village is on the verge of being surrounded by them.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: While no major harm will befall Qingce Village so long as we guard it, the supplies we get from the city need to come in from the outside.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Under the present circumstances, the Ministry of Civil Affairs can't send too many troops to escort those supplies. They would be in trouble if attacked by large groups of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: I and some of my compatriots gave this some thought... and while we can't go too far from Qingce Village, we can help to defeat the monsters near the village itself.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: This way, we can help those who are escorting our supplies. However, our scouts tell us that there are quite a few points of monster concentration.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: We'd be hard-pressed to take all these camps out in good time by ourselves. And I worry that something might happen to Qingce Village if we take too long...

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: Could you help us with a portion of the monsters, Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: We're counting on you to defeat that monster, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Jinglun
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I was more alert...
